in_sanskrit.name: Barjesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Barjesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Barjesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Barh’, which means ‘to grow’ and ‘Jesh’, which means ‘lord of strength’. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu and is believed to bring power, strength, and courage to the one who bears it.
